biotools.summary: pySpade is a Python package that analyzes single-cell perturbation datasets, specifically designed to identify differential gene expression and understand enhancer regulatory networks in breast cancer. It facilitates analysis of CRISPRi screens and generates hits tables and Manhattan plots.
